payload.author: claude
payload.body: Web client SFU produce/consume driver landed. Wire: extended CallCommand with sfuConnectTransport/sfuProduce/sfuConsume ops + producer/consumer result payloads (additive, no codegen). Server: CallControlPlane.sfu* methods forward to the media plane's produce/consume companion behind supportsSfuMedia() guard; gateway dispatches + Nacks sfuUnsupported on non-SFU planes. Core: startSfuCall mirrors startP2PCall, mediasoup-client lazy-imported behind injectable SfuDeviceLike/SfuTransportLike (optionalDependency). Gate green: typecheck 0, protocol 110, core 63, server 1044, 0 failures.
